utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — same community center entrance, and please bring gloves plus any basic tools you have. I’ll make sure both groups get the details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just confirming — same community center entrance, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, same community center entrance. Bring gloves and any basic tools you have, and I’ll make sure both groups have the info.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out for the date and the full list, then pass it along as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Tess — just the date and the full list is plenty. Appreciate you keeping an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the date and the full list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I’m here now—what’s still left to sort for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Dane. Just keep it simple and we’ll handle it in order.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll stick to the plan and help sort everything in order.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still waiting on the date and repair list before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, same here—I only heard it’s coming up soon, but I still don’t have the date or the full repair list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll hold off until we have the date and the full repair list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll check what we already have and what’s still needed for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, thank you, Cleo. I’ll add screws and rags to the list and keep everything organized for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — I’ll see what else we’ve got and bring any missing supplies over for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll jot down the time and the drop-off spot so it stays organized. I don’t want to forget the repair drive again.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps a lot, thanks. If we have the time and the drop-off spot written down, I’ll feel much better about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll write both down and keep them handy so we don’t lose track of the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out for the drop-off spot when you text it. Elm, Pine, then the community hall by 4, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — Elm, then Pine, and the community hall by 4. I’ll text the drop-off spot as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’ll watch for your text and keep the boxes moving along. Elm, Pine, then the community hall by 4, got it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll come by after lunch and start at the porch step.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — I’ll meet you at the porch step after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll see you there after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: You bet, Faye. I’ll be there Saturday at 9:00 AM with my gloves.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli — that’s perfect. See you Saturday at 9, and I appreciate you bringing your gloves.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: You’re welcome, Faye. I’ll see you Saturday at 9:00 AM.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can manage a small amount, and you can come by later this afternoon. Just leave it by the front door, thank you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, I’ll leave it by the front door later this afternoon. What would you like me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just the basics are fine — a few tools or some spare screws if you have them. Thank you, Mina.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — tape, gloves, and screwdrivers are perfect. Just keep me posted on the date and what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ve got tape, gloves, and screwdrivers covered, and I’ll keep you posted since the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll keep an eye out for the fix list too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, for sure — I’ll keep an ear out for the date and the full repair list and let you know as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I appreciate you keeping an ear out — that helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet — I’ll let you know the moment I hear anything new about the drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course — just send me the stops when you have them, and I’ll keep the list organized. I’ve already got the drop-off spot and deadline noted.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll send the stops right over so you can keep the repair drive list organized.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ll keep everything organized once they come in. Thanks, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, that should fit the school schedule well. Send me the date when it’s set, and I’ll help line things up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do — I’m waiting on the date, and I’ll send it your way as soon as it’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — once you have the date, send it over and I’ll make sure it fits around school.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming: it’s still on for after lunch by your front steps, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, still on after lunch by my front steps. Bring gloves and any screws you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — after lunch by your front steps, and I’ll bring gloves and any screws I have.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll stop by tomorrow afternoon to pick them up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Mina — I’ve got them set aside for you tomorrow afternoon. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren. See you tomorrow afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — that would be a big help. Just a quick update: the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’m happy to help with all three on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Sam. I’ll let everyone know the new Sunday location at the community center and keep a list of the screws and rags we still need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the date and what repairs are needed for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still checking on it, Hana — I’ll let you know as soon as I have both the date and the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ll wait for your update once you’ve got the date and repair list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive got a few more sign-ups while I was out—people seem to be getting behind it. If you want, I can swing by and see what else they still need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Ira—thanks. Let me know what they’re short on and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely—I’ll stop by and ask what they’re short on, then I’ll pass it along to you.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll get the word out on the block and help round up a few hands for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — it’s moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send over the stops as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — Sunday at the community center works, and I’ll start inviting folks on the block right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Noah—I’ll see you at the porch step with the flyers and tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — I’m at the porch step and ready to help get things started.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Noah — I’ve got the flyers and tools, and I’m on my way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check the timing and plan, then pass the update along to everyone once it’s clearer.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out for the update and pass it along if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep checking the timing and plan, and I’ll pass along a clear update as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that sounds manageable. I’ll keep an eye on the timing and check in if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep the timing and the who’s-bringing-what list clear, and I’ll let you know if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that should keep things on track. I’ll stay alert for any timing changes and help keep everyone in the loop.
